matched_submap.label: Submap to match
matched_submap.description: Hyprland submap name (define_submap / submap = NAME) that shows the pill. Exact match; every other submap stays hidden.

label.label: Pill label
label.description: Text shown next to the glyph while the submap is active. Leave empty for a glyph-only pill.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Tabler icon shown in the pill. Leave empty for a text-only pill.

use_accent_color.label: Use accent color
use_accent_color.description: Fill the pill with the primary colour and draw the glyph and text in on-primary. Off uses the widget's default colours.
